component.name: Pragma Chess
component.summary: Browse, search and analyze chess game databases

description.p: Pragma Chess is an open source chess database with a native desktop client. Keep your games in databases, replay them on the board, analyze them with any UCI engine and let Explain draw why a move is good or bad.

ul.li: Game databases with filters by opening, tournament, year and source
Games imported from lichess.org and chess.com
Engine analysis and training games against the engine
Databases kept in sync across computers through FTP, WebDAV or Git
